title: Bind complete Core pages and both Gaussian allocation sites to one grid
body:
PR5018's normalized/raw Gaussian allocation bridge did not bind the complete finite Core that probes each interior, chooses a common grid, prepares Schur/LU pages and reconstructs its actual children. This package binds both Core sites without changing their original method bodies or frozen source modules. The written conditional argument retains the same immutable reference, accounts for every computed stage input, regenerates all rounded pages and derives the original complete narrow-inverse/broad-forward error allowance on the new grid.

The original 143-row fixture contains two 16-dimensional interior blocks and 111 boundary coordinates. Narrow Core changes from the frozen predecessor's 261-bit grid to 184 bits, dominated by its boundary floor rather than its 151-bit raw probe. All 28 rounded inverse pages change while the exact LU factors remain identical. Broad Core changes 385→233 bits, dominated by the raw child. Leaving the final raw site unbound actually requests the old 261/385-bit grids and violates the common-grid contract. These are fixture measurements, not universal fixed savings.

The independent exact checker validates inverse-page identities, page errors and grids, every actual stage-input radius and local defect, complete narrow residual/broad direct endpoints, and the full retained invoice. Each case executes 44,352 dense gates and 71,232 rounded outputs; narrow Core retains 18,522 boundary scalar products. Eight controls cover the incompatible old final request, corrupted prepared pages, changed immutable references and omitted genuine upper couplings. Normal CPython3.12.2 replay passes in130.50s. Committed-byte/source-history and official55file export integrity pass; Git-free optimized replay of head 481021540 passes in 134.72 s with all 56 exported files unchanged. A subsequent proof-only peer correction restores the complex-component factor of two already present in the executable budgets; exact archive comparison confirms every executable, input and RESULT byte is unchanged at the final head. A real source mutation is rejected before construction, with export bytes restored exactly.

The Full/downset, Gaussian conditioning, raw wrapper and original Core boundary results remain explicit inherited premises. This is an arithmetic consumer proof and source-bound finite certificate, not physical Tape execution, an independent proof of those analytic premises, core/halo/tensor approximation, native/outer admission or a new kappa. Exact Schur/LU preparation, page delivery, RHS gathering, physical storage and cleanup remain paid but unpriced obligations. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Credit Jose Manuel, Nick Petalas, Vlado, Jeremy Kothe, Chafik, Mason Hale, PR4186, the PR4977/5018 bridge and all retained predecessor notices. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.
